correctness.rationale: The frozen deterministic classification survives. Entropy must increase by exactly two bits per contact in a 12-contact solution, so every joined pair has disjoint supports. Ratios within each existing support persist in that row and all final rows are uniform; hence each intermediate row is uniform and each contact doubles equal support sizes. Sorting contacts by stage commutes contacts on disjoint endpoints, and no edge repeats because once its endpoints share labels they never lose them. An independent exact replay generates all 105 matchings by four-edge subsets, verifies each successful matrix over the rationals, and tests supports against complete labeled cube and Wagner orbits. The 12 two-four-cycle second stages generate 96 cube and 192 Wagner schedules, and the 48 eight-cycle stages generate 48 cube and 144 Wagner schedules, with no others. The Wagner word is exact and its 5-cycle excludes a spanning cube. The frozen ancillary stochastic claim needed repair if stepwise independent full support is interpreted without stationarity: give all edges positive probability but put total probability 2^(-t-1) on edges other than one fixed edge at step t; with positive probability only that edge occurs forever. The repaired claim uses a fixed full-support independent law, hence also covers the equal-rate conjecture. The repair clarifies third-stage complementary groups and removes an unsubstantiated attribution about the earlier paper's open questions. The repaired statements and unchanged deterministic certificate were reassessed.
residual_risks: Only exact, fixed-half pairwise contacts and the twelve-contact support classification are covered; no classification for longer schedules.
